title: Why I don't use Apple products
summary: Louis Rossmann, an independent Apple repair shop owner, explains why he does not use Apple products, drawing on his experience of repairing devices he considers designed to fail and hard to fix.
why: Cited in right-to-repair and Apple threads as an insider's view of Apple hardware design and repairability.

quote.text: I love Louis Rossman's video about why he does not use Apple products.
